brief:
Doctors in the United Kingdom who faced complaints over pro-Palestine social media posts are pursuing legal action against their medical regulator after personal data about them was leaked, Middle East Eye reported. The physicians say they fear for their safety following the disclosure of their information.

The General Medical Council, the UK's medical regulator, has not yet commented on the legal action or the circumstances of the data breach. The case centers on complaints filed against the doctors related to their public statements on social media regarding Palestine.

title: UK doctors accused of antisemitism sue regulator over data breach
